message.zh: Tibi 0.2.0 已发布：新增「电台」播客听读与单句精听/盲听、本地离线 Whisper 语音转写与硅基流动一站式配置；全面升级全站设计系统、语义组件与文案规范。
message.en: Tibi 0.2.0 is out: adds Podcast Radio with synced listen-and-read, free local offline Whisper transcription, one-step SiliconFlow setup, and a unified design system with refined UI copy across the app.
